title: Act: Add API client and ContributionSheet wired into App
summary: Create client.ts contribution calls, ContributionSheet and the App button
description: Implement api/client.ts with createSession, submitContribution, listMine, ApiError; the ContributionSheet component; and a Suggest What Happens Next button in App that toggles it.
acceptance_criteria: client.submitContribution POSTs JSON {world_id,prompt} with credentials include
Sheet renders remaining count and Round-close note
App shows the Suggest What Happens Next button after Begin

steps.symbol: new: ApiError, request, createSession, submitContribution, listMine, WORLD_ID, MAX_PER_PLAYER
steps.action: Create the module: export WORLD_ID='the-boys-room', MAX_PER_PLAYER=5, class ApiError(status,message); request(path,init) prefixes import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL ?? '', sets credentials 'include', throws ApiError on !res.ok; createSession POSTs /api/v1/player/session; submitContribution(prompt) POSTs /api/v1/contributions with body {world_id:WORLD_ID,prompt}, on ApiError 401 calls createSession and retries once; listMine(roundId) GETs /api/v1/player/me/contributions?round_id=
steps.code: export interface Contribution { id: string; world_id: string; round_id: string; player_id: string; prompt: string; created_at: string }
steps.expected: Functions return parsed Contribution JSON and throw ApiError with the HTTP status

steps.action: Create component with props {open,onClose,roundId}; dialog role 'dialog' name 'Suggest What Happens Next' with textarea labelled 'Your idea', Send button, remaining count text 'Contributions left: N', note 'Ideas are considered when the Round closes.', and a list named 'Your suggestions' where each entry shows prompt and state sending/sent/failed; on submit call submitContribution and show error text from ApiError (429 -> 'Slow down, try again shortly', 409 -> 'Limit reached or duplicate idea', other -> 'Could not send')
steps.expected: Sheet renders states and updates history after submit

steps.action: Add useState sheetOpen; inside the scene fragment render a button 'Suggest What Happens Next' that sets sheetOpen true and render <ContributionSheet open={sheetOpen} onClose={()=>setSheetOpen(false)} roundId={round?.id ?? ''} /> where round comes from props-less placeholder undefined until REQ-2 supplies it
steps.expected: Button visible after Begin and opens the sheet

steps.action: Append .contribution-sheet rules: fixed bottom sheet, max-height 70vh, overflow-y auto, padding 1rem, textarea width 100%
